title: Edgar Mitchell's UFO squadron over Germany and the footage taken
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Edgar Mitchell's UFO squadron over Germany and the footage taken, about an unknown time at Washington, D.C., and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Edgar Mitchell who was a naval astronaut who said that in a in a training Mission over Germany he saw over multiple days saw a squadron of like n UFOs that that flew in all these different formations and he had footage of them they said that when he got back to the US in Washington as soon as he landed a military plane landed took the footage never heard about it again
